name: MQTECH
recent: MQ Technology 于2026年9月宣布获得在马来西亚和印尼的AI节能中央空调项目权利，并与相关方签订独家协议。同期，公司完成多笔可赎回可转换债券转换新股上市，董事Terence Cheah Eu Lee在公开市场增持股份。最新财报显示季度营收环比微增0.5%，同比增21.9%，净亏损收窄至22.4万令吉。
notable: 获得在马来西亚和印尼的AI节能中央空调项目权利，并签订独家协议。
完成多笔可赎回可转换债券转换新股上市，涉及78,000,000股新股。
董事Terence Cheah Eu Lee于2026年9月17日至18日合计增持17,000,000股。
risks: 可赎回可转换债券持续转换为新股，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
最新季度仍录得净亏损224,005令吉。
年报股东大会上，Dato' Masrul Affendy bin Masram的连任决议被撤回。
earnings: 2026财年第四季度（截至5月31日）营收为2,771,816令吉，环比增长0.5%，同比增长21.9%；净亏损224,005令吉，净亏损率8.1%，较上一季度的129.6%明显收窄。

recent_en: In September 2026, MQ Technology announced securing rights for AI energy-saving central air-conditioning projects in Malaysia and Indonesia, alongside an exclusive agreement. During the same period, the company completed several listings of new shares from redeemable convertible bond conversions, and Director Terence Cheah Eu Lee acquired shares in the open market. The latest quarterly results show revenue up 0.5% QoQ and 21.9% YoY, with net loss narrowing to RM224,005.
notable_en: Secured rights for AI energy-saving central air-conditioning projects in Malaysia and Indonesia, and entered into an exclusive agreement.
Completed listings of new shares from several redeemable convertible bond conversions, involving 78,000,000 new shares.
Director Terence Cheah Eu Lee acquired a total of 17,000,000 shares on 17-18 September 2026.
risks_en: Ongoing conversion of redeemable convertible bonds into new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
The latest quarter still recorded a net loss of RM224,005.
At the AGM, the resolution for re-election of Dato' Masrul Affendy bin Masram was withdrawn.
earnings_en: For the fourth quarter ended 31 May 2026, revenue was RM2,771,816, up 0.5% QoQ and 21.9% YoY; net loss was RM224,005, with a net margin of -8.1%, significantly narrower than -129.6% in the previous quarter.
